steps.title: Configure Asset Copying for Tesseract eng.traineddata
steps.description: Copy eng.traineddata from assets into context.getFilesDir()/tesseract/tessdata/eng.traineddata and log absolute path and byte length.

steps.title: Create ScanLogItem Data Model
steps.description: Implement ScanLogItem class to encapsulate timestamp, source, barcode value, and full OCR text.

steps.title: Implement ScanLogManager Storage Helper
steps.description: Implement central ScanLogManager helper using SharedPreferences and JSON array to store up to 200 scan log entries ordered newest first.

steps.title: Create Item Scan Log Layout XML
steps.description: Create item_scan_log.xml to present source badge, timestamp, barcode value, and full scanned text in a clean container.

steps.title: Update Activity Main Layout for History Subtabs
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml to include subtab navigation in History screen with dedicated Scan Text Log section and Clear Log button.

steps.title: Integrate Unified Scan Logging in MainActivity
steps.description: Hook camera and gallery scan completions into ScanLogManager.saveScanLog and connect History screen Scan Text Log list and Clear Log button.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Build box-stock-manager APK with enhanced dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract OCR integration, ZXing reader, and persistent Scan Text Log.
